introduction.title: What are Cookies?
introduction.description: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and to provide information to website owners.
introduction.usage: At Caraíba, we use cookies to enhance your browsing experience, analyze website usage, and deliver personalized content. This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, how we use them, and how you can manage your cookie preferences.

management.description: You have several options for managing cookies:

consentTool.description: You can use our cookie consent tool to enable or disable specific categories of cookies. Access your preferences through the cookie banner or by clicking 'Manage Cookies' in the footer.

browserControls.description: Most browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings. You can usually find these options in the 'Options' or 'Preferences' menu of your browser.

browserControls.title: Browser Cookie Controls
browserControls.description: Most browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings. Here are links to instructions for popular browsers:

browsers.firefox: Mozilla Firefox: Preferences > Privacy & Security > Cookies and Site Data
browsers.safari: Safari: Preferences > Privacy > Manage Website Data
browsers.edge: Microsoft Edge: Settings > Cookies and site permissions > Cookies and site data

browserControls.note: Note: Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.

updates.title: Updates to This Policy
updates.description: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We recommend that you review this page occasionally to stay informed about how we use cookies.

contact.description: If you have questions about our use of cookies, please contact us:

yourRights.description: As a data subject, you have the following rights:

access.content: You can request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.

rectification.title: Right to Rectification
rectification.content: You can request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal data.

erasure.title: Right to Erasure ('Right to be Forgotten')

restrict.title: Right to Restrict Processing
restrict.content: You can request limitation of how we process your personal data.

portability.title: Right to Data Portability
portability.content: You can request transfer of your data to another service provider.

object.title: Right to Object
object.content: You can object to processing based on legitimate interests or for marketing purposes.

withdraw.title: Right to Withdraw Consent
withdraw.content: You can withdraw consent at any time where processing is based on consent.

complaint.title: Right to Lodge a Complaint
complaint.content: You can file a complaint with your local data protection authority.
